name: Prone
summary: Crawl or stand (half Speed); Disadvantage on attacks; melee attackers within 5 ft have Advantage, others Disadvantage.
text: Your only movement options are crawling or spending half your Speed (rounded down) to stand up, which ends the condition; with Speed 0 you can't stand. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you, and Disadvantage otherwise.
